description: Check a claim made by an AI vendor or consultant, such as '30% productivity gain', 'cuts support costs by 40%' or 'our agents replace 700 staff'. Returns the questions to ask the vendor, the claim checks, the groups of figures and the company cases by the kind of work AI was used for, so you can find the same result and companies that tried the same kind of tool. Use it whenever someone selling or proposing AI quotes a result. For a statistic from the press or a report, use check_ai_figure.
name: check_vendor_claim
title: Check a vendor’s AI claim
